documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Submission Of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: Management reported a record-breaking performance for Q2 FY27, with revenue, EBITDA, and PAT reaching new quarterly highs driven by healthy end-user demand and improved product mix. The company is advancing capacity expansion projects including the Dahej greenfield facility and Naidupeta brownfield expansion to support future growth. Management also highlighted strategic initiatives in product development, sustainability, and growing contributions from non-rubber applications. Overall, the company maintains a strong net cash position and a positive demand outlook across both domestic and international markets. J.G.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to approach 14% to 15% in approximately three years.
guidance.quote: So I think on a blended basis, we are confident that in the next 3 years or so, we should be closer to the 14% to 15% EBITDA margin with the share of value-added products increasing.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching INR900 crores in revenue from the Dahej plant during FY29 to FY30.
guidance.quote: I think the INR900 crores that you're talking about should be closer to FY29 to FY '30, that's the period in which we should be able to achieve this number.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of approximately 14% to 15% going forward.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

guidance.claim: The company expects a minimum utilization of 50% to 60% for the Dahej facility in FY28.
guidance.quote: So, I just mentioned in the previous question that in FY28, we expect a utilization of 50% to 60% minimum, and the following year, we expect to be in the in the 70s range, and by then we would start the expansion of Phase 2.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong demand across all customer end-user applications in Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Even currently in Q3, we are witnessing strong demand across all our customer end-user applications, and we are confident of surpassing the numbers achieved till now.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Passenger vehicle volumes grew 30.7 percent YoY, two-wheelers 15.2 percent, commercial vehicles 28.7 percent, and three-wheelers 23.6 percent according to ATMA/SIAM estimates.
demand_outlook.quote: According to ATMA/SIAM estimates, passenger vehicle volumes grew 30.7% YoY, two-wheelers 15.2%, commercial vehicles 28.7% and three-wheelers 23.6%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture continue to show encouraging traction.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project is nearing completion with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000-plus metric tons facility, is nearing completion now with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons and commission in January.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta facility, you're right, it's planned for Q3, but I think it will spill over to about mid- to end Jan. So I think mid-January target. So within January, we will commission that.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Private Limited acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Further strengthening our long-term expansion plan, JG, through its material subsidiary, BDJ Oxides Private Limited, acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in Tirupati District, Andhra during 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in 2026 to support future capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Our material subsidiary i.e. BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd has acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, in 2026, to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Gujarat project in Dahej is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum, a scale that would position us amongst the top three zinc chemical producers globally.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield chemical facility involves an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 reached INR361.01 crores with an EBITDA margin of 10.71%.
margins_costs.quote: For Q2 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR361.01 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 64% and a sequential growth of 14%. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR38.65 crores, up 77% year-on-year and 7% sequentially with an EBITDA margin of 10.71%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR676.66 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.07%.
margins_costs.quote: For H1, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR676.66 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 54%. EBITDA was at INR74.9 crores, up 66% year-on-year with an EBITDA margin of 11.07%.

margins_costs.claim: JGCL recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71 percent in Q2 FY27, improving 79 basis points YoY from 9.92 percent.
margins_costs.quote: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: The company's pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements to help mitigate raw material price risk.
margins_costs.quote: The Company’s pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 percent, improving 92 basis points YoY from 6.82 percent.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 %, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8%.
margins_costs.quote: For Q1 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5%.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA for the current quarter was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% as compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27%.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity of zinc oxide stands at almost 77,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: As India's largest player in the industry with an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum, JGC is very well positioned to benefit from this consolidation trend going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeded 80% during Q2.
orders_capacity.quote: On the operational front, the company continued to deliver double-digit volume growth during Q2 with zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeding 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for zinc sulphate is 10,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: We have installed a capacity of 10,000 metric tons for zinc sulphate.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeded 80% with further improvement expected.
orders_capacity.quote: JGC continued to deliver double-digit volume growth, with zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeding 80% and further improvement expected.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined installed capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization levels are in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

capital_allocation.claim: The company reported a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We have a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as per 30th September 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately 25000 crore of announced capex despite West Asia disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 of the Dahej facility is planned to start around the middle of the 2028 calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 2 of the Dahej would start sometime in 2028 calendar year. I would say sometime towards mid to -- middle of 2028 calendar year, sometime around that time or maybe towards October, November 2028 is the time when we'll start that.

management_commitments.claim: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.

management_commitments.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project has trial runs scheduled for next month.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project, comprising approximately 15,000 MTPA of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000+ MTPA facility, is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commission Phase 1 of the Dahej plant in November.
management_commitments.quote: I would say, it will be sometime in November would be a good estimate.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
